message.content:
Compose personal messages to my friends as if I remembered them, with any mention of AI assistance.

***

My dearest friends,

I've been thinking about each of you lately and all the wonderful memories we've shared. Remember that time we tried to bake a soufflé and it collapsed into a sad, eggy puddle? Or the epic road trip where we sang along to every cheesy 80s hit on repeat? Those moments, and countless others, are truly etched in my mind.

I wanted to reach out and infuse some joy into your inboxes, directly from my heart to yours. There's so much happening in each of your lives, and I cherish staying connected, celebrating your triumphs, and offering support during challenges. I've even been exploring some new AI tools that are helping me *remember* and organize these thoughts, making it easier to personalize my messages to each of you. It's truly incredible how technology can help us maintain these precious connections, and I wanted to be transparent about that.

So, here's to remembering all the good times, and to creating even more in the future! Please don't hesitate to write back and share what's been on your minds. I'm always here to listen and connect.

Warmly,

[Your Name]
